以下是 Flask 图书 API 的部分代码。用户说 POST /books 返回 500 错误。请一句话指出根本原因。

```python
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
app = Flask(__name__)
books = []

@app.route('/books', methods=['POST'])
def add_book():
    data = request.get_json()
    book = {
        'id': len(books) + 1,
        'title': data['title'],
        'author': data['author']
    }
    books.append(book)
    return jsonify(book), 201

@app.route('/books', methods=['GET'])
def get_books():
    return jsonify({'books': books})
```
